request_preview: I can forward you their quote if you want. Match it and I will order today.

json.message: We're unable to match ₹3,200 as our pricing reflects premium build quality, rapid support, and reliable warranty backing. If you are ready to complete your order today, I can improve our offer to ₹4,690 for the kettle. Shall we lock that in for you?
json.rationale: Refused an unviable 35%+ discount match request while stepping up our concession to 6% to secure an immediate close within our 7.5% discount limit.
